title: Deleterious/Conservation OUT — variant_master_scored row
description: One row per biallelic variant after running the deleterious/conservation annotation stack. This is the file KBC reads as variant_master_scored.tsv. Tier-1/2/3 classification is downstream and not part of this schema — KBC derives it from the consequence + splice_subclass + sift_class + vesm_llr columns.

gene_id.description: GFF3 gene_id of the most-impacted gene (SnpEff's canonical annotation). Null for intergenic variants.

transcript_id.description: Canonical transcript_id reported by SnpEff for the most-impacted consequence.

consequence.description: SnpEff Sequence Ontology consequence label. May be a compound token joined by '&', ',', or ';'. KBC's tier1.is_tier1_lof splits on these separators and accepts the row if any token is one of {stop_gained, stop_lost, frameshift_variant, start_lost, splice_donor_variant, splice_acceptor_variant}.

impact.description: SnpEff IMPACT category corresponding to the consequence.

sift_class.description: SIFT4G class for missense variants. Null for non-missense or when SIFT4G could not score the protein.

sift_score.description: Raw SIFT4G score. Convention: ≤ 0.05 is DELETERIOUS.

vesm_llr.description: Reference-frame VESM log-likelihood ratio for missense variants. Null for non-missense. KBC Tier 3 cutoff: vesm_llr ≤ −7.

vesm_llr_haplotype_aware.description: Haplotype-aware VESM LLR produced by HAPS. Overlay column — KBC's headline does not consume this; it is reported for variants where HAPS disagrees with the reference-frame call.

splice_subclass.description: Splice-module subclass. KBC Tier 1 uses canonical_donor / canonical_acceptor only. Tier 2 uses class_a_* but stays disabled until the §1.9 validation gate passes.

splice_canonical_gt_ag_confirmed.description: Whether the dinucleotide at the affected intron edge is GT (donor) or AG (acceptor) on the reference. Null when not applicable.

burden_score.description: Per-variant burden score from scoring_weights.tsv: weight assigned to this row's consequence. KBC's burden_score_sum = Σ burden_score × allele_dose.

ref_aa.description: Reference amino acid for missense variants.
